  type TEXT NOT NULL,

name: batches
sql:
CREATE TABLE batches (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	project INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id),
	key TEXT NOT NULL,
	target INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES targets (id),
	job TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('human', 'auto', 'agent')),
	actor INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actors (id),
	run INTEGER,
	build_url TEXT,
	state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('accepted', 'processed')),
	counts TEXT NOT NULL,
	staged TEXT,
	receipt TEXT,
	at INTEGER NOT NULL,
	seq INTEGER NOT NULL, nothing_required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (nothing_required IN (0, 1)), shard INTEGER CHECK (shard IS NULL OR shard >= 1), shards INTEGER CHECK (shards IS NULL OR shards >= shard), model TEXT CHECK (model IS NULL OR method = 'agent'),
	UNIQUE (project, key)
) STRICT

) STRICT

name: cases
sql:
CREATE TABLE cases (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	project INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id),
	no INTEGER NOT NULL,
	-- STANDING, written only by the effect of an `adopt` decision:
	head INTEGER NOT NULL,
	head_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
	claim_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
	title TEXT NOT NULL,          -- copies of head.body fields, so a list page needs no body
	methods TEXT NOT NULL,
	automate TEXT NOT NULL,
	step_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
	folder INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES folders (id),
	rank TEXT NOT NULL,
	tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
	state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (state IN ('active', 'archived')),
	aliases TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
	created_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actors (id),
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
	updated_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actors (id),
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
	rev INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'case' CHECK (kind IN ('case', 'fragment')),
	UNIQUE (project, no)
) STRICT

name: change_ends
sql:
CREATE TABLE change_ends (
	change INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES changes (id),
	ended TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ended IN ('merged', 'closed')),
	at INTEGER NOT NULL
, landing_commit TEXT, landing_repo TEXT, landing_branch TEXT CHECK (
	(landing_commit IS NULL AND landing_repo IS NULL AND landing_branch IS NULL)
	OR (ended = 'merged' AND landing_commit IS NOT NULL AND landing_branch IS NOT NULL AND landing_branch IN ('main', 'master', 'trunk'))
), receipt INTEGER REFERENCES merge_receipts (id)) STRICT

	url TEXT,
	files TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
	rev INTEGER NOT NULL, head_observed_seq INTEGER,
	UNIQUE (project, key)
) STRICT

name: credentials
sql:
CREATE TABLE credentials (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	actor INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actors (id),
	-- oidc and totp are not built. They are named because SQLite cannot widen a CHECK afterwards.
	kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('password', 'passkey', 'oidc', 'totp')),
	-- A passkey's credential id, base64url. Null for a password.
	handle TEXT,
	-- A password: the argon2id string, which holds its own salt and cost. A passkey: JSON with the public key
	-- (SPKI, base64url), its algorithm, the counter of its last sign-in, its transports and its backup flags.
	data TEXT NOT NULL,
	label TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
	last_used_at INTEGER,
	revoked_at INTEGER
) STRICT

sql:
CREATE TABLE results (

	actor INTEGER NOT NULL,
	-- What this result proves: exact (a pinned slot, a manifest or an annotation), assumed (the case's head at
	-- ingest, recorded as an assumption) or unresolved (no case; history only).
	basis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (basis IN ('exact', 'assumed', 'unresolved')),
	basis_case INTEGER,
	basis_version INTEGER,
	basis_claim TEXT,
	outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('pass', 'fail', 'skip', 'blocked', 'error')),
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	duration_ms INTEGER,
	signature INTEGER REFERENCES signatures (id),
	message TEXT,
	detail TEXT,
	at_step TEXT,
	trail TEXT,
	note TEXT,
	run INTEGER,
	corrects INTEGER REFERENCES results (id),
	at INTEGER NOT NULL
, quarantine_decision INTEGER REFERENCES decisions (id), quarantine_exit INTEGER REFERENCES decisions (id), model TEXT CHECK (model IS NULL OR method = 'agent')) STRICT

	signature INTEGER,
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL,
	flipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	-- who reported it and where: "<target>:<job>:<actor>". A test has one row per lane, so one job's pass (or
	-- another producer's) never replaces a different job's failure; only a newer attempt in the same lane does.
	lane TEXT NOT NULL,
	-- the target of the lane (a commit in one environment): an excuse held for one target counts here only
	target INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES targets (id),
	PRIMARY KEY (run, test, lane)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

name: runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE runs (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	project INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id),
	no INTEGER NOT NULL,
	name TEXT NOT NULL,
	origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('change', 'planned')),
	accepts TEXT NOT NULL,
	-- for a change run: the target's `what`, so the gate read by CI is one lookup
	accepts_what TEXT,
	-- for a change run: where its failures are answered ("change:<id>", "line:trunk@<repository>")
	scope TEXT,
	require TEXT NOT NULL,
	change INTEGER REFERENCES changes (id),
	-- STANDING (signoff):
	state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (state IN ('open', 'closed')),
	signoff INTEGER REFERENCES decisions (id),
	-- the horizon: an accepted upload is outstanding until it is applied, and the gate is pending meanwhile
	accepted_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	applied_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	outstanding INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	next_expiry INTEGER,
	-- projections written only by the run fold:
	tally TEXT NOT NULL,
	blocking TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
	verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('passed', 'failed', 'blocked', 'pending')),
	created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
	rev INTEGER NOT NULL, quarantined INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	UNIQUE (project, no)
) STRICT

sql:
CREATE TRIGGER receipt_quarantine_insert AFTER INSERT ON quarantines
WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM quarantines WHERE project=NEW.project)=1
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO merge_receipt_dirty(run,bucket)
 SELECT rt.run,rt.result/32 FROM run_tests rt JOIN merge_receipt_heads h ON h.run=rt.run
 WHERE h.project=NEW.project AND rt.result IN (SELECT id FROM results WHERE quarantine_decision IS NOT NULL)
 ON CONFLICT(run,bucket) DO NOTHING;
END
